Job Summary

Sr Consultant role requiring eight to ten years of experience in Property and Casualty Insurance focused on delivering high quality consulting outcomes in a hybrid work model during day shifts without travel requirements enabling clients to improve underwriting claims and policy servicing efficiency while supporting the organization mission of responsible and sustainable growth.

Responsibilities

• Drive end to end consulting engagements for Property and Casualty Insurance clients to optimize underwriting rating and claims operations while aligning solutions with strategic business objectives and regulatory expectations.
• Analyze complex policy administration billing and claims processes to identify operational bottlenecks and design practical process improvements that enhance service quality and reduce handling time.
• Collaborate closely with client business stakeholders and technology partners to translate insurance domain requirements into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation.
• Develop detailed requirement documents process maps and user stories that capture rating logic coverage structures and claims handling rules in a format that can be readily implemented by delivery teams.
• Guide clients through target operating model definition for Property and Casualty portfolios by assessing current capabilities identifying gaps and proposing phased roadmaps for transformation initiatives.
• Perform impact assessments for changes in underwriting guidelines regulatory mandates and product structures and recommend mitigation plans that minimize disruption to ongoing business operations.
• Configure and validate insurance platform solutions such as policy administration components rating engines or claims modules to ensure they reflect agreed business rules and coverage features.
• Conduct system and user acceptance testing of Property and Casualty solutions by preparing test scenarios executing test cases logging defects and validating fixes against business expectations.
• Prepare and deliver clear client ready presentations status reports and workshops that explain findings options and recommendations in a structured and actionable manner for various stakeholder groups.
• Support production rollout activities by coordinating user training process documentation and post implementation reviews to ensure stable adoption and measurable business benefits.
• Mentor junior consultants in Property and Casualty concepts artifacts and best practices enabling them to contribute effectively to client engagements and strengthen overall team capability.
• Work within hybrid teams across locations and time zones to ensure that design decisions configuration changes and defect resolutions are documented consistently and communicated promptly.
• Align all consulting activities with organizational policies on ethics compliance data privacy and risk management ensuring that client outcomes contribute positively to societal trust in the insurance ecosystem.

Qualifications

• Possess eight to ten years of hands on experience in Property and Casualty Insurance across areas such as underwriting policy administration claims or billing with a strong understanding of personal and commercial lines products.
• Demonstrate practical knowledge of core insurance concepts including rating factors coverage limits deductibles endorsements reinsurance and loss control practices applied in daily consulting work.
• Exhibit proven experience working on transformation or system implementation projects for insurance carriers managing requirements testing and rollout activities in a structured consulting environment.
• Apply strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret data from policy systems claims repositories or financial reports and convert insights into actionable recommendations for clients.
• Utilize excellent communication and workshop facilitation skills to engage diverse stakeholders such as underwriters claims handlers actuaries and technology specialists in hybrid work settings.
• Show familiarity with modern insurance platforms or digital solutions such as policy administration suites claims management tools or customer service portals used in Property and Casualty initiatives.
• Display comfort with working in a hybrid work model that combines onsite and remote collaboration while maintaining productivity during day shifts without requiring travel.

LatentView Analytics is looking for a Data Scientist to join our fast-growing analytics team in Chennai. The ideal candidate will be skilled in statistical modelling, machine learning and generating business insights that drive strategic decisions for global clients.

Experience: 4 to 8 years

• Develop and deploy machine learning solutions for business problems.

• Communicate findings and actionable insights through reports, dashboards, and presentations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams. Data engineering, business stakeholders, and domain experts.

Location : Pune
About Team & About Role:

 

As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

 

 
Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.
  • Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.
  • Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.
  • Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.
  • Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.
  • Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.
  • Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.
  • Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).
  • Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.
  • Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

Requirements

Must-have
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory.
  • Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS.
  • Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.
  • Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
  • Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
  • Simple, effective written and verbal communication.
Nice-to-have
  • Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
  • HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).
  • Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).
  • Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.
  • Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).
